name: Love of Ren'ai Koutei of LOVE!
original_name: らぶおぶ恋愛皇帝 of LOVE！
source:
School president (emperor) [url=/c21983]Ichinose Rukina[/url] wins at everything no matter what it is. However, there's one exception: love. She proclaimed her love for her childhood friend Akito in front of the whole school, and now many other girls are after him as well!?

[Edited from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
学生会长（皇帝）一之濑留奈在任何事情上都所向披靡。然而，有一个例外：恋爱。她在全校面前向青梅竹马秋人表白了爱意，结果现在其他女孩们也都盯上了他！？

[编辑自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
